description: The Instituto Nacional de Estatística of Guinea-Bissau posts the thematic analyses of its 2009 General Population and Housing Census on a census documents page, next to regional population reports, 1991 census results and the questionnaires of the 2025 census. The volume on household living conditions has tables by urban or rural area and by region on dwelling type and tenure, wall, roof and floor materials, main form of lighting, drinking water supply, toilets and sewerage, cooking energy, waste disposal, and ownership of electrical appliances and means of transport. It reports that only 54.6 percent of the population had access to drinking water from protected sources, and that piped water reached 47 percent of households in the Autonomous Sector of Bissau but very few elsewhere. Coverage is national by region. Format and access: free PDFs, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: data are from 2009; tables are inside a PDF report; results of the 2025 census were not on the page. Simulation uses: regional gaps in water supply and building materials for flood and storm exposure. Related records: none for Guinea-Bissau censuses in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Quadros 44 to 59: households by dwelling type, tenure, rooms; dwellings by wall, roof and floor material by dwelling type, urban or rural and region. Quadros 60 to 73: main form of lighting, drinking water supply and water for other uses, toilet facility, type of sewerage, main cooking energy and waste disposal, by urban or rural and by region. Quadros 74 to 79: ownership of electrical appliances and means of transport and communication.
